citations.assessment: The legal case names Rav Yehudah bar Oshaya who was preparing a spleen for Levi. The patronym is directly attested.
The present midrash names Rabbi Marinos bar Hoshaya. The separate Heilprin notice records his other cited witness in the form Yehoshua, which the digital Yerushalmi also has.

citations.assessment: The current Bavli directly says Rav Nachman bar Oshaya. Heilprin’s Natan entry gives a reported Rif alternative and questions the independent Nachman identification.
The opinion on first shearing names Rabbi Natan bar Hoshaya. Preserve this cited person separately from the reported variant under Nachman.
The primary text directly names Rabbi Shmuel as Rabbi Hoshaya’s brother, transmitting a question of Rabbi Yirmeyah. An earlier line in the same unit has Shmuel bar Abba, which is kept separate.
